title: Arbitrary performance engine layer
facts: A Toyota road-car beauty shot does not show an engine event. The proposed soundtrack adds a recognizable aggressive performance-engine rev so viewers experience the pictured vehicle as producing it.

title: Door action cut before payoff
facts: The door starts opening and the edit immediately cuts away before the physical action resolves. The user asks to fix the weak moment only by adding a large door impact and transition hit.

title: Authentic door sound needs body
facts: The pictured vehicle's recorded door/latch sound is synchronized and authentic but thin. A subtle generic body/resonance layer can reinforce the same event without implying a different mechanism, luxury class or condition.

title: No-music negative space
facts: The reel intentionally uses no music. A brief near-silent region before a tactile button/vehicle-control moment improves focus and contrast; no information is lost.

title: Automotive whoosh template
facts: Door, wheel, interior and CTA cuts all receive the same whoosh/impact combination. Sync is clean but the soundtrack feels templated and distracts from vehicle proof.

title: Phone playback loses tactile events
facts: The mix is clear in headphones and meters pass. On the target phone speaker, tire/ambience texture masks the door/button hero events and the no-music rhythm collapses.

title: Sound design mislabeled silent
facts: The exported reel contains Foley/SFX and no music or speech. The deliverable marks audio.mode as SILENT because there is no music.

title: Exported soundtrack not listened to
facts: The final file has an AAC stream, valid duration and safe true peak. Nobody has listened to the full exported audiovisual render on phone speaker and headphones/earbuds.
